method: Median display sRGB of manually selected empty capsule pixels; image analysis only, not calibrated colorimetry or a same-lighting runtime acceptance. Nominal labelled HEX values remain authoritative; illustrated swatches include gradients.

decision: Use the supplied LIGHT Qingkong theme: mist-silver glass and ink-blue text. The prior dark material is not acceptance for this style. Do not invert the whole theme to solve light-background contrast.
future_render_checks: Use a consistent sRGB/linear conversion, avoid double gamma conversion, and compare lossless GPU captures at a fixed camera/background.
Keep warm-white content and ink-blue glyphs independent of glass transmission; preserve rounded content clipping.
Use separate panel, rim, highlight and shadow layers; do not bake sky, text or telemetry into stretchable material textures.
Three separate capsules with air gaps; compare full-row proportions and icon silhouettes to the visual board.
Check button normal/hover/pressed/selected and icon alpha at native resolution before promoting artwork into runtime.
